name: Chemical & Systems Biology-MS

rules.name: Requirements Overview
rules.desc:
Students in the PhD program may apply for an MS degree after satisfactorily completing the course and laboratory requirements of the first two years. The degree also requires a written thesis based on literature or laboratory research. Postdoctoral research training is available to graduates having a PhD or MD degree.
Coursework: Normally, if a course has the option to be taken as a letter grade, the student must take the course as a letter grade and receive a B- or better to have the course count towards the CSB PhD requirements.

rules.name: PhD First Two Years - Course and Laboratory Requirements

children.name: Subsequent Quarters
children.notes:
• BIOS 263: Applied Grant-Writing Skills for Fellowships (Spring)

• To be taken once, after selecting a thesis advisor. Students use their Qualifying Exam Proposal and/or skills obtained in this course to apply for fellowships and grants during their time in CSB ( e.g., NIH F31, NSF, etc.). Choose another scientific writing course if you have already secured a fellowship.

• CSB 270: Research Seminar (Fall, Winter, and Spring)

• To be taken fall, winter, and spring of years one and two

• CSB 399: Graduate Research (Fall, Winter, Spring, and Summer)

• To be taken every quarter

• MED 255: The Responsible Conduct of Research (Fall, Winter, or Spring)

• To be taken once

children.name: One Chemical Biology Course
children.notes: If CSB 260 and Chem 281 are both offered within the same year, you should take CSB 260 for this requirement.

children.name: One Additional Elective
children.notes: Other electives are possible with approval from the Student Advisory Committee.

rules.name: Qualifying Exam and Thesis

children.name: Written thesis based on literature or laboratory research

rules.desc: The degree requires students to pass a qualifying exam and produce a written thesis based on literature or laboratory research. Postdoctoral research training is available to graduates having a PhD or MD degree.

grading: Normally, if a course has the option to be taken as a letter grade, the student must take the course as a letter grade and receive a B- or better to have the course count towards the CSB PhD requirements.
reviewNotes: The MS is for CSB PhD students who have finished the first two years of coursework: the listed required courses (with CSB 270 in the fall, winter and spring of years one and two), one chemical biology course, two CSB electives and one more elective, for 45 units in all. Each of these courses must be letter graded with a B- or better when a letter grade is offered; courses offered only S/NC, like CSB 399 research, count as they are. An elective the Student Advisory Committee approves, or a writing course in place of BIOS 263 once you hold a fellowship, is moved in by hand. You check by hand the qualifying exam and the written thesis.
